title: How will I, as a parent, stay involved in my child’s Occupational Therapy programme at Pinnacle?
metaTitle: Family Involvement in Your Child’s Occupational Therapy at Pinnacle Blooms
description: Discover how parents stay involved in their child’s occupational therapy program at Pinnacle Blooms. Regular updates, setting therapy goals, and home support training to enhance the therapy process.
html: At Pinnacle, we believe in the importance of family involvement. Parents are regularly updated on their child's progress, involved in setting therapy goals and given training to support the therapy process at home.
